That cuts against transparent, independent scrutiny.","question_ids":["7B.6","7B.3"]},{"title":"China watch-dog doubles down on Xi’s anti-graft drive","publisher":"Reuters / MarketScreener","date":"2024-01-10","url":"https://hk.marketscreener.com/news/latest/China-watchdog-doubles-down-on-vow-to-heed-Xi-s-anti-graft-drive-45713924/","summary":"The anti-graft apparatus said it would catch “corrupt and disloyal” officials, which frames investigations as loyalty enforcement as much as anti-corruption.","question_ids":["7B.6","7B.5"]},{"title":"China targets financial sector with party-led anti-graft committee","publisher":"Reuters / MarketScreener","date":"2024-07-24","url":"https://hk.marketscreener.com/news/latest/China-targets-financial-sector-with-party-led-anti-graft-committee-47453350/","summary":"A new anti-graft committee in finance is led through political supervision and “party building,” showing tighter Party control rather than independent compliance review.","question_ids":["7B.6","7B.5"]},{"title":"Hong Kong bureau shuts after Article 23 fears","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-03-29","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/usfunded-radio-free-asia-shuts-hong-kong-bureau-citing-security-law-concerns-3358157","summary":"Article 23 created enough risk that an independent bureau closed, showing the environment was hostile to investigative reporting.","question_ids":["7B.6","7B.3"]},{"title":"Hong Kong no accountability 5 years after mass protests","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-06-10","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/06/10/hong-kong-no-accountability-5-years-after-mass-protests","summary":"HRW said Hong Kong had no independent police-complaints mechanism and that authorities offered no accountability for abuses. That is direct evidence against independent oversight.","question_ids":["7B.6","7B.3"]},{"title":"Factbox: scope of Hong Kong’s new national security laws","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-03-19","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/factboxscope-of-hong-kongs-new-national-security-laws-3344082","summary":"Article 23 broadened sabotage, sedition, and state-secrets offenses and could impose life imprisonment, expanding the toolkit for secrecy and control.","question_ids":["7B.6","7B.3"]},{"title":"CAC orders control over “self-media”","publisher":"Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission Office","date":"2024-04-23","url":"https://www.cac.gov.cn/2024-04/23/c_1715545670217049.htm","summary":"The cyberspace campaign ordered real-name verification, source labeling, throttling, suspensions, and account closures, making independent reporting riskier and harder.","question_ids":["7B.6","7B.3"]},{"title":"Xi inspected Rocket Force brigade amid purge of senior officers","publisher":"Xinhua / Reuters / SCMP","date":"2024-07-18","url":"https://www.scmp.com/news/china/military/article/3270993/chinas-communist-party-targets-another-pla-general-corruption-investigation?UUID=f0bc4b91-7818-4f96-bf67-aa5b46ac9395&next_article_id=3270939&tc=7&tpcc=enlz-globalimpact","summary":"The purge of Rocket Force officers overseeing nuclear missiles shows internal discipline, but it was a loyalty-heavy internal purge, not independent investigation of Xi or his close circle.","question_ids":["7B.6","7B.5"]}]}
